items.title: Blackstone (BX) Stock Looks Fairly Valued Following Its 25% Slide
items.summary: Blackstone has had a tough year in the market, with the stock down 25.4% year to date. That slide puts fresh focus on a basic question for investors: Is the current share price a fair reflection of the returns the asset manager earns on the capital it deploys across real estate, credit, infrastructure and private equity? items.title: GSK (LSE:GSK) Settles Key Vaccine Patent Case And Wins Broad Europe Injunction
items.summary: GSK (LSE:GSK) reached a cross-licensing agreement with Moderna resolving their COVID-19 vaccine patent dispute in Europe. The pharma group secured a significant injunction against Pfizer-BioNTech covering liposome delivery technology used in RNA vaccines across multiple European markets. Ongoing legal actions and expected appeals around this RNA and liposome IP framework now shape how the largest vaccine makers operate in Europe.
